candidates.text:
Pan Global Resources is expanding its footprint in northern Spain.

The company’s bids for the Salamón Gold Project have been accepted, subject to the disposition of an ongoing appeal from a competing bidder.

Salamón sits along the 100km-long León Fault and just 30km east of Pan
